ElementType.name: FilePropertySupport
ElementType.description: FilePropertyType is restricted to the following values: Ignore, Obscure, Normal Any unrecognized value will be treated as "Ignore".

ElementType.name: Property
ElementType.description: The Property defines the image or frame property (as determined by the IsImageProperty element) to which the meta-data from the file format will be copied.

ElementType.name: IsImageProperty
ElementType.description: IsImageProperty should be defined as a numeric value, using 0 for frame properties and any non-zero value of IsImageProperty for image properties

ElementType.name: FilePropertyCollection
ElementType.description: The Count element is present for documentation purposes only, and is ignored when the collection is opened.

ElementType.name: FilePropertyConfig
ElementType.description: The Count element should be set equal to the number of FilePropertyCollection elements.
